description: Top all-wheeled racers contend in a bone-jarring, kidney-bruising romp in the Nevada desert; an exclusive inside look at the private collection of car auctioneer Craig Jackson.

title: The Guild Garage
description: Dave is excited to see a Model T roll into the Guild, and gets Ron on to fire up the engine; the team installs a new engine in a '67 Firebird.

title: The Guild Garage
description: Dave tasks new hire Jessica to figure out why the headlights on his Model A hot rod don't work; Brad installs a digital instrument panel in a restored C10; the '62 Rambler is off with Greg to Comic-Con to meet French Stewart.

title: The Guild Garage
description: Talon installs a serpentine kit on a '67 Firebird engine; a '74 Triumph is in for some TLC, but Ron hears a mysterious noise during the test drive; Barry paints a new steering wheel for a '53 Packard.

description: Jessica installs a new radio in the '53 Packard, while Ron investigates a weird sound coming from the new engine in a '68 Charger; Talon fits a custom-made driveshaft into the '67 Firebird.

title: The Guild Garage
description: Brad picks up a beautiful 1977 Cadillac DeVille that has great sentimental value, but a lot of rust; Talon shores up the Caddy with some expert welding; Dan gets to work redoing the upholstery on a 1986 Buick Grand National; Ron does the tune-up.
